p1_findings.title: Arbitrary file read and execution via Vitest UI server
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker on the same network as a developer running the Vitest UI server can read arbitrary files from the developer's machine and execute arbitrary code
p1_findings.fix: npm install vitest@latest in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p1_findings.title: JavaScript injection via AST type confusion and template injection RCE
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Backend compiles user-supplied or attacker-controlled Handlebars template → arbitrary JavaScript execution on the server
p1_findings.impact: Server-side RCE via template injection; prototype pollution → XSS
p1_findings.fix: npm audit fix in Source/Backend; remove or upgrade handlebars

p1_findings.title: Arbitrary code execution via protobufjs code generation gadget
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides a malicious .proto file or crafts a gRPC message exploiting the code generation gadget chain → arbitrary code executed in the portal backend process
p1_findings.impact: Full process compromise of portal/Backend; prototype injection in message constructors
p1_findings.fix: npm install protobufjs@latest OR upgrade @opentelemetry/sdk-node to ≥0.221.0

p1_findings.title: Spec-Source ID Mismatch — Source traces to Plan IDs not Specification IDs
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any agent asked to implement a requirement from Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md will find 0 implemented counterparts in Source/; the traceability enforcer gives a false 0% result; future agents build against wrong assumptions
p1_findings.impact: Structural breakdown of spec-first workflow; CLAUDE.md architecture rule violated at scale
p1_findings.fix: Add FR-WF-* IDs to Specifications/workflow-engine.md OR add Spec↔Plan cross-reference tables in each Plan. Update traceability-enforcer.py accordingly.

p1_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md FR-001…FR-069 entirely unimplemented in Source/
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Agent tasked with implementing a missing feature references this spec (SQLite store, entity names, API shapes) but Source/ implements a different in-memory engine; agent produces conflicting code
p1_findings.impact: Misleading authoritative document; agent misdirection; spec-first contract broken
p1_findings.fix: Formally mark FR-001…FR-069 as deferred/out-of-scope with a note about the architectural pivot, OR create a reconciliation plan for incremental implementation
